newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile Refugio gold mine to open at weekend.
newsitem.headline: Chile Refugio gold mine to open at weekend.

text.p: Work will restart this weekend at Chilean Refugio gold mine's open-cast pit which has been closed for a month because of heavy snow, said a mine official.
"This weekend everything will be normal. The problem is over," human resources manager Anibal Avendano told Reuters by telephone from Copiapo.
The pit was forced shut mid-June after blizzards dumped several meters of snow over the mine and cut access roads to Copiapo.
Refugio's heapleaching plant continued operating while the pit was shut, although gold output was lower than usual, said Avendano.
"The plant was always working as it processes solution from the leach pads," he said.
"I can't say what the level of prodcution has been, although it is obviously less than budgeted."
The mine, owned equally by Canada's Bema Gold and Amax Gold, is designed to produce 230,000 ounces of gold a year.
